See `../validation/RESULTS.txt` and `../validate.sh`. (The gate's own evidence below is from the earlier Leakproof run, which had no project tests.)

Issue: https://github.com/gpac/gpac/issues/4006
Defect: heap-buffer-overflow in `gf_fopen_ex` (`src/utils/os_file.c:1721`). Gate verdict: **verified**; evidence: verified, needs human review.

## The patch

`0001-isomedia-nul-terminate-an-in-memory-meta-item-full-path.patch` (this directory), `git format-patch` form: apply with `git am 0001-isomedia-nul-terminate-an-in-memory-meta-item-full-path.patch`. The
author is `<your git identity>` unless `--author` was given; fix it with
`git commit --amend --reset-author`.

```diff
diff --git a/src/isomedia/meta.c b/src/isomedia/meta.c
index ea5705d..dc01012 100644
--- a/src/isomedia/meta.c
+++ b/src/isomedia/meta.c
@@ -1769,10 +1769,11 @@ GF_Err gf_isom_add_meta_item_extended(GF_ISOFile *file, Bool root_meta, u32 trac
 		/*store full path for info*/
 		else if (!location_entry->data_reference_index) {
 			if (data) {
-				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * data_len);
+				infe->full_path = (char *)gf_malloc(sizeof(char) * (data_len + 1));
 				if (!infe->full_path) return GF_OUT_OF_MEM;
 
 				memcpy(infe->full_path, data, sizeof(char) * data_len);
+				infe->full_path[data_len] = '\0';
 				infe->data_len = data_len;
 			}
 			else if (resource_path) {
diff --git a/src/isomedia/unittests/ut_meta_item_memory.c b/src/isomedia/unittests/ut_meta_item_memory.c
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..641dfe2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/isomedia/unittests/ut_meta_item_memory.c
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+#include "tests.h"
+#include <gpac/isomedia.h>
+
+/* An in-memory item keeps a copy of its bytes in infe->full_path. On write,
+ * DoWriteMeta opens full_path as a file name when data_len is 0, so the copy
+ * must be NUL-terminated (#4006: heap-buffer-overflow read in gf_fopen_ex).
+ * Under --enable-sanitizer, the unpatched library aborts inside gf_isom_close(). */
+unittest(meta_item_memory_zero_length)
+{
+#if !defined(GPAC_DISABLE_ISOM) && !defined(GPAC_DISABLE_ISOM_WRITE)
+	const char *path = "meta-item-memory.mp4";
+	/* Exact-size heap buffers with no terminator, as callers pass them. */
+	char *payload = gf_malloc(3);
+	char *empty = gf_malloc(1);
+	GF_ISOFile *file = NULL;
+	GF_Err e;
+	u32 data_id = 0, empty_id = 0, out_size = 0, out_alloc = 0;
+	u8 *out = NULL;
+
+	assert_not_null(payload);
+	assert_not_null(empty);
+	if (!payload || !empty) goto exit;
+	memcpy(payload, "abc", 3);
+	empty[0] = 'x';
+
+	/* Edit mode: items stay in memory until gf_isom_close() writes the file. */
+	file = gf_isom_open(path, GF_ISOM_WRITE_EDIT, NULL);
+	assert_not_null(file);
+	if (!file) goto exit;
+	e = gf_isom_set_meta_type(file, GF_TRUE, 0, GF_4CC('t', 'e', 's', 't'));
+	assert_equal(e, GF_OK, "%d");
+	if (e) goto exit;
+
+	/* Valid control: a 3-byte item. */
+	e = gf_isom_add_meta_item_memory(file, GF_TRUE, 0, "data", &data_id, GF_4CC('m', 'i', 'm', 'e'),
+		"text/plain", NULL, NULL, payload, 3, NULL);
+	assert_equal(e, GF_OK, "%d");
+	if (e) goto exit;
+
+	/* Trigger: a zero-length item; its full_path is later used as a file name. */
+	e = gf_isom_add_meta_item_memory(file, GF_TRUE, 0, "empty", &empty_id, GF_4CC('m', 'i', 'm', 'e'),
+		"text/plain", NULL, NULL, empty, 0, NULL);
+	assert_equal(e, GF_OK, "%d");
+	if (e) goto exit;
+
+	/* Writing reaches DoWriteMeta -> gf_fopen(full_path): over-read without the fix. */
+	e = gf_isom_close(file);
+	file = NULL;
+	assert_equal(e, GF_OK, "%d");
+	if (e) goto exit;
+
+	/* The 3-byte item round-trips through the written file. */
+	file = gf_isom_open(path, GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ, NULL);
+	assert_not_null(file);
+	if (!file) goto exit;
+	e = gf_isom_extract_meta_item_mem(file, GF_TRUE, 0, data_id, &out, &out_size, &out_alloc, NULL, GF_FALSE);
+	assert_equal(e, GF_OK, "%d");
+	assert_equal(out_size, 3, "%u");
+	if (out && out_size == 3) assert_equal_mem(out, "abc", 3);
+
+exit:
+	if (file) gf_isom_delete(file);
+	gf_file_delete(path);
+	if (out) gf_free(out);
+	if (payload) gf_free(payload);
+	if (empty) gf_free(empty);
+#endif
+}
```

## Planner's analysis (written before the fix; check it against the diff)

Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote this root-cause analysis before any patch existed. It can describe a
different mechanism than the one the final diff fixes, so it is here for the reviewer and never
in the commit message.

> In meta.c, infe->full_path is allocated with exactly data_len bytes and memcpy copies data_len bytes without ensuring null termination. When gf_fopen later reads this path, it reads past the allocation looking for a null terminator, causing heap-buffer-overflow.

## Commit message (in the patch)

```
isomedia: NUL-terminate an in-memory meta item's full_path

When a meta item is added from memory, meta.c copies its bytes into
infe->full_path with exactly data_len bytes and no terminator. For a
zero-length item, DoWriteMeta() in isom_store.c takes the
"!data_len && full_path" branch and passes full_path to gf_fopen() as a
file name, which reads past the allocation (heap-buffer-overflow in
gf_fopen_ex, #4006).

Allocate one more byte and terminate the copy. A zero-length in-memory
item now gives an empty name, gf_fopen() fails and the existing
"if (!src) continue;" skips the item, as for any unreadable file.

Add a unit test that writes a file with a zero-length in-memory item.

Fixes #4006
```
